results.question: How many units of the top-selling product from my first question were refunded?
results.sql: WITH top_product AS (SELECT p.product_id FROM products p JOIN variants v ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN order_lines ol ON v.variant_id = ol.variant_id JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(ol.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT SUM(rl.quantity) AS refunded_units FROM top_product tp JOIN variants v ON tp.product_id = v.product_id JOIN order_lines ol ON v.variant_id = ol.variant_id JOIN refund_lines rl ON ol.order_line_id = rl.order_line_id;
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: How many units of the top-selling product from my first question were refunded? Resolved the top-selling product from the first question (Canvas Tote) and summed the refunded quantities from refund_lines.
results.answer: A total of 165 units of your top-selling product, the Canvas Tote, were refunded. This count is based on summing all the refunded quantities recorded in your refund data.
